composition.content_safe_zone: Nearly the full stage. A 28px light edge on the right is the only breathing field.
composition.environment_breathing_zone: The right paper edge and a thin wash of morning light. No architecture competing with amounts.
composition.panel_max_width: 100% of the content column, which itself stops before the light edge.
composition.cta_width_policy: No broad lifestyle CTA. Search and filter are inline square controls.
composition.icon_row_policy: GRID icon | merchant label | amount. Date and category sit in the label column.
composition.mobile_behavior: 393×852. The list scrolls inside the app. The page does not.
composition.tablet_behavior: 834×1194. Ledger measure caps near 560px, left weighted.
composition.desktop_behavior: 1440×900. Ledger column at margin-left 72px, max 640px. Quiet field remains.
